description: Land Acquisition - Kamburupitiya, Kamburupitiya D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain lands are required for public purpose and provides detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including their extent, location, boundaries, and survey details. The content deals exclusively with land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
